Definition: an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board)
BiblicalUsage: God says to virgin Israel, set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest. The word is an erection, a pillar, a guide-board: the marker set up so the exiles can find the road home. It appears once, in the promise of return.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the waymarks are God's kindness to the returning: He does not only call them home, He marks the road, so the way back can be found.
